text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: No matter how many times I reread it, it's just wonderful. Especially this scene where the knight protects the prince from the dragon.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
If this were Trainer and me—
"Stop, Durandal! Don't throw your life away!"

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"Nay! Honor is my very life...
Even should I be reduced to a single speck of ash,
so long as I protect thee, my soul shall be immortal!"

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Ah, the ideas just keep coming to me!
In other scenes too—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...She didn't go into detail about the reason,
but it seems Durandal ended up staying up late.
